learning_objective: 🎯 Let us read a wonderful story about true friendship and how much animals love us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Badal is a kind boy, and Moti is his cute little puppy. They love spending all their time together.
Every evening, Badal and Moti run in the fields. Moti wags his tail and jumps high to catch his favourite ball.
Animals are our best friends. When we show love to them, they protect us and love us back even more.

fun_activity.title: 🐾 Pet Portrait
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a picture of Moti the puppy playing with a ball. If you have a pet, draw your pet too!

quick_recap: ⭐ Badal and Moti are the best of friends.
⭐ They love playing and running outside together.
⭐ We should always be kind and loving to animals.
